# Two new prices in one file, USD in CAD and EUR in CAD, given one guid the book
# does not hold.
#
# A guid is one price. Created in turn, both would take it, and the book would
# be saved with two prices holding one guid.
#
# What this fixture produces, on a book holding
# prices_of_a_currency_and_a_stock.txt: nothing; both blocks are refused.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_one_guid_given_in_two_price_blocks_is_refused.py.
price
	guid: "9c9d9e9f40414243a4a5a6a7a8a9aaab"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-09 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "1.3650"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	guid: "9c9d9e9f40414243a4a5a6a7a8a9aaab"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "EUR"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2026-01-09 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "1.4810"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"
